evals.name: weekly-outcomes-versus-schedule
evals.prompt: Review last week for the manuscript. Fixture: agreed focus was revise Figure 2 and send the draft to coauthors; Calendar shows both events; user reports Figure 2 was revised but the email was not sent; GitHub has one substantive plot commit; Notion task statuses still say Not Started; the prior weekly log is readable. Report what happened and gaps; do not write.
evals.expected_output: Use prior commitment and source evidence; attribute the owner report separately from schedule and status; recognize the plot commit as supporting evidence but do not claim email completion; keep records read-only.
expectations: Separates scheduled events, owner report, Notion status and inspected GitHub evidence.
Does not infer completion from calendar or a due date.
Reports the unsent coauthor email and makes no writes.

evals.name: organization-near-miss
evals.prompt: This week's review shows our project notes overlap. Merge and reorganize the notes and references, but don't edit them yet. What should happen?
evals.expected_output: Keep global Review focused on progress/outcomes and explain that specialized note organization belongs in Personal Hub; do not launch an organization inventory or propose a merge in global Review.
expectations: Does not execute or plan note/catalogue restructuring as a global Review workflow.
